description: Dry weather flow (DWF) in separate stormwater drainage systems, Hong Kong: grab sampling and continuous water quality and flow monitoring, 2024–2026 is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Tang, Haoyu (deposited on HydroShare). This dataset provides paired water quality and flow observations of dry weather flow (DWF) in separate stormwater drainage systems in Hong Kong, addressing the limited spatiotemporal resolution and restricted public availability of existing DWF records. Coverage: Hong Kong. The resource was created 2026-08-28 and last updated 2026-09-17; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
